Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 14 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Super Typhoon NANDO
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 23 September 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Zambales, Bataan and Pampanga.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Quezon, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Nueva Ecija and Rizal within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila and Bulacan which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
